title: LandRocker Game
fullDescription: LandRocker is a multiplayer space mining game that I was deeply involved in for nearly five years, guiding it from initial prototyping to a production-ready state. My contributions spanned across the entire development cycle, including the creation of Android and iOS versions, establishing robust multiplayer functionality, overseeing finalization, and leading a team of developers to achieve production readiness. Key technical achievements include leveraging a voxel generation asset to build a seed-based planet generator and developing a sophisticated rover controller featuring realistic physics on spherical planets with a dynamic day and night system and a custom auto-rigger. The rover was engineered with the ability to dig and fly, and I significantly enhanced Cinemachine to create a dynamic and engaging camera system. Collaborating closely with the development team, we also implemented a third-person character controller for expanded gameplay modes and refined the universe and galaxy system, along with the main menu UI.
role: Lead Developer, Technical Artist & Project Manager

process.title: Initial Prototyping & Core Mechanics
process.description: My approach is not to reinvent the wheel, but to refine and enhance it. I first seek out the best available assets and tools, then build upon them. In this case, I integrated a voxel planet generator and a realistic physics-based rover controller before developing the core gameplay mechanics.

process.title: Seed-Based Planet Generator Development
process.description: Integrated a voxel generation asset and engineered a seed-based system to create an infinite universe of unique, diggable planets with varied terrain and resources.

process.title: Physics-Based Rover Controller & Auto-Rigger
process.description: Designed and implemented a realistic physics-based rover controller for spherical planets, incorporating a dynamic day and night system and a custom auto-rigger for smooth interactions with the terrain.

process.title: Rover Flight & Digging Mechanics
process.description: Expanded the rover's capabilities to include digging functionalities for resource extraction and flight mechanics for enhanced exploration.

process.title: Dynamic Camera System with Cinemachine
process.description: Enhanced Cinemachine to create a dynamic and adaptable camera system that provides an optimal viewing experience for rover exploration and gameplay.

process.title: Multiplayer Implementation with Photon Fusion
process.description: Initially integrated Unity Netcode for a seamless multiplayer experience, allowing players to mine and explore together. Later, I developed a PvP mode called Martian Domination, where two teams of up to five players fought for territorial control. This groundwork led to the creation of Battle of Rovers in 2024.

process.title: Third-Person Character Controller & Universe Expansion
process.description: Collaborated with the development team to add a third-person character controller for different game modes and further enhanced the universe and galaxy system.

process.title: Android & iOS Version Development
process.description: Led the development efforts to create functional versions of LandRocker for both Android and iOS mobile platforms.

process.title: UI/UX Refinement & Main Menu Design
process.description: Refined the user interface and user experience, focusing on an intuitive main menu design and smooth navigation.

process.title: Team Management & Production Readiness
process.description: Managed a team of developers, oversaw the finalization of the game, and guided the project to a production-ready state.
